A.notes: Site A delivers a strong, cohesive concept anchored by the beautiful data visualization of the 140 hectares. The pinning and sequential reveal of the icons perfectly ties motion to the story. The typography seamlessly handles both scripts, though the implementation of the icon grid triggered a listitem axe violation.

B.notes: Site B functions well but feels indistinguishable from a standard corporate template. It lacks any purposeful motion to engage the user or highlight the brief's narrative. While clean in accessibility metrics, the design choices are overly safe and uninspired.
